mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar / registry of companies in the foreign investor's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize in the issuing country; then, if the issuing country is a Hague Apostille Convention member, obtain an Apostille from the competent designated authority and submit in China; if the issuing country is not an Apostille member, authenticate through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of that country and then legalize the document at the Consular Department of the Embassy/Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that country. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel alternatives and must never be chained.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), Articles 23-26, 37-43, 50, 57-62, 96-109, and 172; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019) and its Implementing Regulations; Securities Law of the People's Republic of China (2019 Amendment), Articles 111-128
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation / local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) at municipal and district level in the intended registered jurisdiction
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form and Application Form for Registration of a Company, filed through the National Enterprise Registration and Credit Information Publicity System / National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an ordinary limited liability company under the Companies Law; however, because the entity intends to hold a securities brokerage licence under the CSRC, the Securities Law requires a minimum registered paid-up capital of RMB 50 million, fully paid in cash and verified by bank confirmation before the securities business licence is issued. For incorporation, there is no blocked escrow account requirement; capital contributions must be deposited into the company's verified bank account and documented for each shareholder subscription. The paid-up licensed capital must remain intact and may not be withdrawn until the licensed securities business ceases.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CHINA JOINT VENTURE LIMITED (THE COMPANY). RESOLVED, at the first meeting of the Board of Directors duly convened and held on the date specified in the minutes, at the registered office of the Company, with all directors present and constituting a quorum, and in accordance with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, the Foreign Investment Law, and the Articles of Association of the Company, as follows: 1. CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND RECEIPT. The Board acknowledges the adoption of the Joint Venture Contract and the Articles of Association. The registered capital of the Company is the amount stated in the Articles. Each shareholder's subscribed capital, contribution schedule and method of payment are hereby ratified. Management is directed to deposit all subscribed capital into the dedicated corporate bank account and to maintain ledger entries evidencing each contribution, any premium, and the bank confirmation statement. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The designated banker of the Company shall be the bank named in the banking authorization form. The Chairman and the Chief Financial Officer are authorized, jointly and severally, to open, operate, and close corporate, foreign exchange, payroll, settlement, and segregated client accounts. Any payment larger than the threshold set by the Board requires two authorized signatures. Client money shall not be commingled with the Company's own assets and shall be held in segregated trust accounts. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The Board ratifies the lease or title documents for the registered office at the address stated in the Articles, and the Secretary is directed to file such documents with the Administration for Market Regulation and any other authority requiring filing. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. The following persons are appointed as officers: the named director as Chairman and legal representative, the named director as Chief Financial Officer, the named director as Secretary, and the named director as Compliance Officer. Each appointee is deemed to accept office and to satisfy the fit-and-proper requirements of the China Securities Regulatory Commission. The legal representative and the Chief Executive Officer are authorized to execute incorporation filings, apply for seals, engage auditors, make statutory declarations, and represent the Company before all competent authorities. 5. GOVERNANCE AND FURTHER RESOLUTIONS. The Board establishes an audit committee and a risk-management committee, and directs the Compliance Officer to prepare an anti-money-laundering and client-asset protection manual before the regulatory licence application is made. FURTHER RESOLVED that all actions taken by the Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer prior to this meeting in connection with incorporation, share subscription, bank account opening and regulatory filings are ratified and confirmed. This resolution is effective immediately and shall be transmitted to the registered office, bankers, auditors and the China Securities Regulatory Commission. A certified true copy of this resolution shall be executed by the corporate secretary for filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name reservation and drafting of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) via the National Enterprise Name Reservation Service and the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name-reservation application for the limited liability company, choosing a corporate name that contains a distinctive administrative division, trade designation, business characteristic and the suffix limited company. Simultaneously, the founding shareholders must execute the joint venture contract, shareholders' agreement and Articles of Association. Foreign investors' signatures, board appointments and legal representative appointment forms must be notarized at a Chinese notary or legalized at the PRC embassy or consulate in the investor's home jurisdiction and, if required, translated into Chinese by a sworn translator. The proposed business scope must expressly exclude any regulated securities activity until the CSRC licence is granted.
required_dossiers: Online name reservation application
Passport or business licence of each shareholder
Certificate of incorporation of corporate shareholders, where applicable
Notarized powers of attorney for signing representatives
Proposed Articles of Association and Joint Venture Contract draft
Board member and legal representative appointment letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, refile a revised name after rectifying identical or deceptively similar names. If the application is queried, resubmit with a notarial clarification within five working days and request an expedited review under the SAMR service rules. If the constitutional documents are challenged, amend and re-execute the relevant clauses and file a supplementary explanation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Securities brokerage licence pre-approval or pre-application assessment with the CSRC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) Administrative Licensing Acceptance Centre and the provincial CSRC representative office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal application to the CSRC Administrative Licensing Centre for a securities brokerage licence before completing the final company registration. The application must demonstrate the proposed business scope, shareholder suitability, independent directors, compliance system, risk management, internal control and capital adequacy. Founders should execute the joint venture contract and Articles of Association with a condition precedent that the entity will not engage in any licensed activity until the CSRC licence is granted and the local AMR business license reflects the restricted post-licensing scope. All foreign shareholder notarization and legalization documents must accompany the application, together with the proposed fit-and-proper statements of directors and senior officers.
required_dossiers: Securities brokerage licence pre-application enquiry letter
Feasibility study and business plan
Shareholders' qualifications evidence
Draft internal control and compliance policies
Capital adequacy projection statement
Fit-and-proper statements for directors and senior officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CSRC raises a deficiency, respond within the official statutory deadline with legal opinions, amended business plans and supplementary corporate governance documents. If the application is suspended for missing documentation, submit the missing items under the CSRC notice timetable. If the pre-application is rejected, correct the stated grounds, strengthen the compliance and capital plan, and refile after the applicable cooling-off period or seek administrative reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company establishment registration and issuance of business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) through the National Enterprise Registration and Credit Information Publicity System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the establishment registration application together with the name reservation notice, Articles of Association, joint venture contract, capital contribution schedule, registered office lease certificate, identification documents of all directors, supervisors and senior managers, and the legal representative appointment. All electronic documents must be signed with the recognised personal digital certificates of the legal representative and shareholders. The AMR will review the information, verify that the business is not in a prohibited foreign investment category, issue the unified social credit code and print the business license. After registration, apply for official company seals at a licensed seal engraving company after filing with the public security bureau.
required_dossiers: Name reservation approval notice
Notarized and legalized Articles of Association
Joint Venture Contract
Capital contribution schedule and bank confirmation
Registered office lease or certificate of ownership
Passport or identity documents of each director, supervisor and officer
Legal representative appointment form and identification
Certificate of approval, if any, from CSRC pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AMR issues a formal correction notice, cure the identified defects within the statutory correction period, upload amended pages and resubmit. If the application is suspended for suspected name infringement or unlawful scope, file a written explanation with supporting notarized evidence and request a written decision subject to administrative reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation tax, social insurance, bank account activation and formal CSRC licence filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tax Service Bureau under the State Taxation Administration, local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, Public Security Bureau, designated commercial bank, and the CSRC licence window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after receiving the business license, complete tax registration and tax-identification information, corporate social insurance registration, statistical declaration, and the opening of corporate basic deposit, foreign exchange and payroll accounts. The legal representative and finance officer must personally attend banking interviews. Then formally file the securities brokerage licence application with the CSRC, enclosing the certified charter, proof of paid-in capital, fit-and-proper statements, compliance manual, risk management plan and bank confirmation. No brokerage operations may occur before the licence is granted and the business license is amended to reflect the approved brokerage scope.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code certificate
Articles of Association and joint venture contract
Company seal filing certificate and legal representative identity document
Bank account opening confirmation
Tax registration forms and tax identification number proof
Social insurance registration form
Statistical declaration forms
CSRC securities brokerage licence application with all supporting attachments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or social insurance registration is delayed, pay any late filing penalties and apply for a compliance waiver with a reasoned explanation. If the bank account opening is deficient, provide corrected anti-money-laundering due diligence materials. If the CSRC licence application is returned, respond to the CSRC notice of missing documents within the prescribed 30-day period; if rejected, correct the stated grounds and refile after a cooling-off period or seek administrative reconsideration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) and local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) for physical office establishment and limited business registration

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Listed in the EIA Classification Management List; exempt from EIA registration and full EIA report because the licensed activity is pure financial brokerage with no physical manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly or warehousing installation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. The activity does not generate process wastewater, VOC point-source emissions, hazardous industrial waste, or regulated atmospheric discharges. The only obligations are proper disposal of office waste, e-waste and paper under municipal waste classification regulations and the national hazardous waste list, and compliance with indoor office air quality standards for occupied commercial premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety acceptance inspection and fire prevention certification for the office premises from the local Fire and Rescue Section under the Fire Protection Law; structural load statement from the landlord for the leased commercial space; workplace safety registration with the local Emergency Management Bureau for low-risk office occupancy; and occupational hygiene inspection confirming acceptable indoor environmental conditions for employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); online filings are made through the STA National Electronic Tax Bureau service platform operated by the local competent tax authorities
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the Sino-foreign equity joint venture, the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) obtained from the State Administration for Market Regulation at incorporation is the statutory Tax Identification Number for all PRC tax purposes. The SAMR transmits incorporation data to the STA through the multi-license integration mechanism; the local tax service bureau automatically completes tax registration and assigns the entity's taxpayer classification. The entity must thereafter activate e-tax access, complete taxpayer type confirmation, register for VAT invoice issuance, and file monthly/quarterly returns. For a foreign non-resident entity without a Chinese permanent establishment, the Chinese payer or withholding agent must complete a non-resident enterprise tax registration with the relevant tax authority and record the non-resident's home-jurisdiction TIN before paying Chinese-source income; a separate PRC USCC is not generally issued to such non-residents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable to entity classification; the PRC does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. A small-scale VAT taxpayer may elect general VAT taxpayer status if annual taxable turnover is below RMB 5 million and the taxpayer satisfies the accounting, bookkeeping and filing requirements; this is an indirect-tax status election, not an entity classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: PRC Value Added Tax (VAT) under the VAT legislation and STA implementing rules; general standard rate 13% for goods, 9% for certain goods and services, 6% for financial and securities brokerage services, and 3% small-scale VAT collection rate
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover measured over any consecutive 12-month period is the mandatory threshold for registration as a general VAT taxpayer; entities below this threshold may remain small-scale taxpayers unless they elect otherwise. The joint venture is required to complete VAT registration upon establishment even below the turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates the use of the full digitalized electronic invoice (all-electronic invoice) service platform of the STA. Invoices must be issued through the e-tax/e-invoice platform or an approved API-integrated billing system, and invoice data is transmitted to the STA's Gold Tax System (Phase IV) in near real time. Each valid invoice must carry a unique nationwide invoice number, digital anti-fraud stamp, QR code and electronic signature. Financial and brokerage invoices must describe the commission or fee service accurately; input VAT credit claims, exemption/zero-rating declarations and invoice data are cross-checked automatically against customs records and foreign-exchange data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under PRC VAT, the 0% rate applies to goods that are physically exported from mainland China under a completed customs export declaration, and to cross-border taxable services that are expressly included in the zero-rating catalogue issued by the STA (covering categories such as international transportation, R&D, design, software, integrated circuit design and certain offshore outsourcing/digital services). The recipient must be a non-resident enterprise or individual, payment must be made by the non-resident in foreign currency or RMB from an offshore account, and the service must be consumed wholly outside mainland China. Retail securities brokerage services and CFD/equity agency services are not automatically included in the zero-rating list; such services are generally taxable financial services at 6% unless they qualify for the cross-border services VAT exemption. To claim zero-rating for any qualifying goods or offshore digital services bundled with the brokerage, the entity must separately document the exported goods/digital service and satisfy all statutory conditions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (export declaration form) showing the goods under customs supervision and physical export from mainland China; this is not required for pure brokerage services
Bill of Lading or equivalent international transport waybill evidencing the movement of goods to the foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank foreign-exchange receipt voucher evidencing full payment received from the non-resident purchaser within the prescribed repatriation period

Cross-border service contract and commission agreement, evidence of offshore consumption and performance, the non-resident client's tax-residence documentation, and payment traces for the exported brokerage or digital service
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA can retrospectively disallow zero-rating or exemption and claw back refunded VAT with statutory late-payment surcharge at 0.05% per day on the underpaid amount. Fraudulent or unverified documentation attracts a monetary penalty from 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection; serious export-tax fraud cases are referred for criminal liability under the criminal law, and false invoices or forged customs/foreign-exchange documents may lead to prosecution and imprisonment. The STA, customs authority and State Administration of Foreign Exchange share cross-border data systems for automated audit scrutiny.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The PRC maintains de facto current-account convertibility under Article VIII of the IMF Articles of Agreement. Trade-related foreign exchange purchases and settlements are processed freely by licensed banks against genuine documentation. Capital-account items, however, including inbound equity injections, shareholder loans, dividends, and offshore securities investments, remain subject to explicit SAFE registration, quotas, or case-by-case approval. Export proceeds are no longer subject to any mandatory surrender ratio, but they must be repatriated into mainland China and either retained in a licensed bank foreign exchange account or converted into RMB at the enterprise's discretion. In practice, profit remittance hurdles for a Sino-foreign securities brokerage include full verification of paid-in capital, completion of annual statutory audits, submission of tax clearance certificates, and evidence that all SAFE reporting obligations have been discharged. Dividends declared in foreign currency require audited financial statements, a board resolution declaring the distribution, a foreign exchange payment purpose code validated by the paying bank, and proof of withholding tax payment. The central bank may impose additional documentary scrutiny where the business scope involves derivatives or overseas retail clients, as such typologies raise perceived balance-of-payments and AML risk. Therefore, while the RMB is not freely convertible on capital account, the entity can function with a well-structured onshore banking relationship, active SAFE compliance, and continuous tax and treasury governance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the SAFE Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Administration Measures, export foreign currency receipts must be repatriated to mainland China within 90 days after the export customs declaration date. There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio; the exporter may retain 100% of export proceeds in a designated foreign exchange account at a licensed bank or convert them into RMB at the prevailing onshore rate. However, for enterprises rated below standard by SAFE, enhanced monitoring may require immediate full settlement and the submission of monthly reconciliation reports.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs are not viable as a primary clearing sponsor for a mainland China legal entity. Under PRC law, only licensed commercial banks and designated foreign exchange banks may operate foreign exchange accounts and process current-account settlements for onshore companies. Non-bank fintech EMIs cannot legally hold corporate escrow accounts, issue capital verification evidence, or satisfy SAFE capital-account reporting. They may be used only as ancillary collection channels if they partner with an onshore licensed bank, but the treasury backbone must remain with a domestic tier-1 commercial bank to meet regulatory reality.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative and at least one authorized director must appear physically in a mainland China bank branch for biometric identification and the compliance interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted for corporate account opening. For non-resident directors, passport notarization or mainland embassy/consulate legalization is required, and the bank will apply dual control with a branch manager and AML compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk securities brokerage classification involving retail CFDs, equities, and derivative instruments creates inherent money-laundering layering risk through rapid trading and cross-border funding flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the CSRC or equivalent securities brokerage license, the SAFE operating registration certificate, an institution-wide AML/CFT manual, a transaction monitoring system attestation with audit trail architecture, independent penetration testing of trading rails, audited financial statements for the last three years, and source-of-funds declarations for every ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sino-foreign joint venture ownership with a multi-layer offshore parent structure may obscure the true economic capacity and control chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a complete corporate custody chain from the mainland JV up to the ultimate natural persons, including certified copies of passports, corporate registry extracts, shareholder registers, trustee or nominee declarations, an international legal opinion confirming beneficial ownership, personal bank reference letters, and a fund provenance narrative for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity capital injection without effective SAFE foreign direct investment registration or a certified capital verification report will be rejected by the bank and may trigger a sanctions review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the approval certificate for the foreign-invested enterprise, the domestic business license, the SAFE FDI registration form, a capital verification report issued by a licensed PRC CPA, a chronological bank statement of the capital escrow account, the board resolution authorizing the injection, and the specific SAFE foreign exchange purpose code assigned to the inbound remittance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential disguised distribution of profits through offshore vehicles or recurring related-party transactions that circumvent PRC foreign exchange control.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide board minutes approving each dividend or distribution, withholding tax payment certificates, audited annual accounts, tax filing receipts, transfer pricing documentation covering all related-party transactions, bank payment confirmations with SAFE purpose codes for each outbound transfer, and sworn declarations from the foreign parent that no profit was moved offshore outside SAFE approval.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder must remit via SWIFT MT103 to the JV's capital escrow foreign exchange account held at a licensed PRC bank. The wire must clearly include the SAFE inbound capital purpose code for equity investment (e.g., code 6111 for foreign direct investment in equity). The receipt must be matched against the SAFE FDI registration file. Within 30 days after receipt, the entity must complete the required SAFE registration update and obtain a capital verification report from a licensed PRC CPA before the funds can be converted to RMB or transferred out of the escrow account for operating expenditures.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements can be executed through SWIFT MT103 direct wire transfers against invoices, contracts, and transport documents; commercial letters of credit (sight or usance, typically 90 to 180 days); and documentary collections including D/P and D/A. Every outbound payment must be submitted through the SAFE ASOne system or the bank's counterpart system with a validated foreign exchange payment purpose code, the underlying transaction document, tax payment certification, and if applicable, customs declarations for goods trades.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY forward contracts with licensed banks under genuine hedging exposure arising from trade or investment cash flows.
Cross-currency swaps (RMB versus USD or EUR) approved by SAFE for long-term asset-liability management, subject to demonstrated real exposure and matching maturity.

European-style FX options purchased from licensed banks for hedging the spot price risk of committed trade flows; NDFs are prohibited as onshore instruments and may only be used by offshore parties outside the PRC boundary.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June immediately following the reporting fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the annual report is not published by 30 June, the company is placed on the SAMR List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operating Activities within 10 working days; continued non-rectification for 3 years triggers administrative strike-off or revocation of the business license. Knowingly false annual-report data also attracts a fine of RMB 10,000 to RMB 100,000 and personal registration restrictions against the legal representative.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) jointly administered with SAMR through the Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Service System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 30 June for the preceding calendar year; new joint-venture initial reporting within 30 days of completion of foreign-investment registration and change reporting within 30 days of any qualifying change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission, misstatement or untruthful reporting triggers a correction order and entry in the enterprise credit record; refusal to rectify within 20 working days can result in administrative fines of up to RMB 100,000 and can suspend eligibility for subsequent foreign-exchange, licensing and cross-border regulatory filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement and Payment Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (SAT) through the in-charge local tax service bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 May of the calendar year following the tax year; quarterly provisional income tax prepayments are due within 15 days after each quarter-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of unpaid tax; late filing may attract a fine of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000, while underpayment, evasion or false declarations attract an additional penalty of 50% to 500% of the tax amount involved. Persistent delinquency can result in bank-account freezes, asset seizure, enforced SAT tax deregistration and exit restrictions on responsible officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Securities Company Financial Report and Independent CPA Audit Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), local CSRC regional bureau and applicable securities exchange
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end, being on or before 30 April for a 31 December year-end, or an earlier accelerated deadline imposed by CSRC licence conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or false filing is an information-disclosure violation punishable by warnings and fines of up to RMB 500,000 against the company and up to RMB 200,000 against responsible officers; aggravated or repeated violations may cause suspension or administrative revocation of the securities brokerage licence, mandatory special-purpose audit by a CSRC-appointed firm and criminal referral.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Owner Annual Confirmation and Change Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and SAMR through the joint beneficial-owner registry filed via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation must accompany the SAMR annual report by 30 June; any change in beneficial ownership, including a share transfer or control-chain modification, must be reported within 30 calendar days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or inaccurate UBO filing is an anti-money-laundering compliance breach; PBOC may issue correction orders and impose fines of up to RMB 50,000 for first failures and up to RMB 100,000 for repeated or serious failures. CSRC may treat the breach as a fitness-and-propriety event, impose enhanced licence conditions, restrict segregated client-asset permissions or suspend licence approvals.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent audit by a licensed PRC certified public accountant is mandatory for every Sino-foreign equity joint venture and for every licensed securities brokerage without any SME exemption. Quantitative surveillance bright-lines under the PRC accounting, tax and CSRC supervision framework are: total balance-sheet assets equal to or exceeding RMB 50 million; total annual brokerage commissions and fee income equal to or exceeding RMB 30 million; segregated client assets under custody equal to or exceeding RMB 100 million; or 200 or more full-time employees. Crossing any one of these thresholds triggers the enhanced mandatory CPA audit, accelerated CSRC filing and a special-purpose audited securities-brokerage report in addition to the general statutory annual audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (Chinese GAAP / ASBE), substantially converged with IFRS; for the licensed brokerage the CSRC Supplementary Rules on Securities Company Information Disclosure and Financial Reporting also apply, and tax-basis schedules are prepared under the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the PBOC and SAMR Beneficial Owner Information Registration Measures, the joint venture must identify every individual who alone or jointly controls 25% or more of equity or voting rights or who otherwise exercises actual control. The legal representative must certify the beneficial-owner statement annually through the SAMR annual report portal by 30 June. Any equity transfer, equity pledge, inheritance or change in the control chain must be reported to the PBOC/SAMR registry within 30 calendar days and must be reflected contemporaneously in the on-site Register of Members and board minutes. The AML compliance officer must keep the UBO investigation files, identification documents, control-chain diagrams and risk classification materials available at the registered office for on-site CSRC and PBOC inspection.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 - USD 5,000 per year for a licensed registered address and registered agent in a Mainland commercial hub; USD 4,000 - USD 9,000 per year if full corporate secretarial and filing-agent services are outsourced.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 12,000 - USD 38,000 per year for a high-risk securities brokerage joint venture, including CSRC-scope consolidated audit, special-purpose regulatory reporting and AML data testing.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General statutory enterprise income tax rate is 25%. Qualifying small low-profit enterprises with taxable income up to RMB 3 million may benefit from an effective reduced tax burden under the progressive preferential regime, but a licensed securities brokerage is unlikely to qualify. A National High and New Technology Enterprise may use 15%; qualified R&D expenditures receive a 100% additional deduction. No patent box regime is available, and offshore securities brokerage income does not automatically qualify for free-zone or tax-holiday benefits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return Form A100000 (A-Class) together with supporting schedules A105000, A107011, A108000, and A109000, filed through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax filing portal eTax@China.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement balance with quarterly provisional payments; monthly VAT and monthly non-resident withholding tax declarations for cross-border payments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual corporate income tax return must be filed and the final balance paid before May 31 immediately following the calendar year-end; quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; monthly VAT and withholding tax returns are due within 15 days after the end of each calendar month.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report the Chinese JV's gross income from all business sources, including securities brokerage commissions, CFD spreads, derivatives execution fees, account maintenance fees, and custody revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide income of the Chinese resident JV under Articles 1 and 6 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law. Do not characterize offshore brokerage fees as nontaxable foreign-source income unless the transaction negotiation, client onboarding, execution, and risk management are genuinely performed outside China and fully documented. If any portion is booked in a non-resident affiliate, contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of earning the operating revenue, such as exchange transaction costs, clearing and settlement fees, market data subscriptions, and third-party commission rebates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only costs supported by qualified invoices or valid vouchers are deductible. Payments to non-resident affiliates for data, technology, or execution services must satisfy the arm's length standard and may trigger withholding tax on service fees characterized as royalties or as services attributable to a Chinese establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-income taxes such as urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge, and other consumption levies attributable to the current period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Corporate income tax, penalties, and late surcharges are not deductible. VAT actually borne on nonexempt purchases is not included here; input VAT should be handled through the VAT return. Ensure cross-border VAT and SPA arrangements do not cause double-deducted surcharge claims.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Client acquisition commissions, marketing spend, business development entertainment, and promotional costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Entertainment expenses are capped at 60% of actual spend but cannot exceed 0.5% of the period's operating revenue. Commissions paid to non-resident introducing brokers must be substantiated with definitive service contracts, evidence of actual referral functions, arm's length pricing, and the relevant withholding filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Management payroll, rent, office outsourcing, professional fees, regulatory fees, and travel.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Salaries and fees paid to non-resident directors, consultants, or regional officers are deductible only if the services are actually rendered and the JV proves economic substance. Excessive allocations of head-office expenses from a foreign parent are not automatically deductible and require an allocation methodology accepted by the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest expense, bank charges, settlement fees, unrealized and realized foreign exchange losses, and financing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to non-resident shareholders is subject to the thick capitalization rule under Article 46 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and a 2:1 debt-to-equity safe harbour from the interest deduction disallowance. Excess interest may be recharacterized as a distribution and subjected to dividend withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impairment of accounts receivable, intangible assets, goodwill, and other financial assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: General bad debt provisions are not deductible; only actual losses supported by statutory evidence may be recognized. For cross-border receivables from non-resident affiliates, the tax authority will disregard an impairment unless litigation, insolvency, or ongoing collection is convincingly documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unrealized gains and losses on financial instruments held at fair value, particularly derivatives and CFDs held by the brokerage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Unrealized gains are generally included in taxable income and unrealized losses are generally deductible only if the accounting and tax treatment converge. Hedge accounting relationships, trading positions with non-resident counterparties, and valuation models should be supported by an independent transfer pricing or valuation file to avoid mark-to-market challenges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dividends, interest, and gains from equity or debt investments held by the JV.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received from Chinese resident enterprises are tax-exempt under Article 26 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law if the underlying profits were taxed in China. Dividends from offshore subsidiaries are included in taxable income with a foreign tax credit for the underlying foreign taxes. Outbound dividends paid by the JV to a non-resident investor trigger 10% withholding tax absent treaty relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed as Box 1 less Box 2 through Box 9 and adjusted for impairment and fair value movements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This accounting result is before non-operating items and is not the taxable amount. Ensure all related party transactions have been benchmarked under the arm's length principle before carrying this figure into tax adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gains on disposal of fixed assets, government subsidies, restitution, penalties received, and other irregular income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Taxable subsidies must be included unless they are specifically designated as tax-exempt. Subsidies received from a non-resident government or foreign entity may carry source country tax treatment and should be reviewed for deemed taxable income under China's territorial and resident world-wide taxation rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Donations, fines, non-ordinary losses, and other expenses outside operating activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fines and tax penalties are never deductible. Charitable donations are deductible only through approved organizations and within 12% of annual total profit. Donations or write-offs made to non-resident affiliates are not deductible absent a real business purpose and complete documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit before tax shown in the statutory financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the starting point for CIT reconciliation. For a non-resident-owned JV, the accounting profit must not differ from the audited financial statements; unexplained discrepancies will trigger a joint tax and regulatory inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back non-deductible expenditures and unreported taxable income, including excess entertainment, excess advertisement, non-qualifying impairments, tax penalties, and transfer pricing upward adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the tax authority has made a transfer pricing adjustment, the increase must be reflected in the year to which the adjustment relates. For cross-border payments, any disallowed expenses must avoid double-counting with withholding tax and VAT obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reduce taxable income for tax-exempt income, tax-exempt dividends, government grants that are non-taxable, and other deductions created by specific tax preferential provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax-exempt dividend relief requires that the upstream Chinese enterprise has already paid CIT and that the dividend chain is within the statutory exemption rules. Amounts relating to non-resident shareholders must not be claimed unless the JV is the actual recipient and a valid tax residence certificate exists for foreign-source refund claims.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 16 / Box 16 - Taxable Income after Loss Offsets
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after applying prior-year tax loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: China permits a five-year carryforward period for general enterprise losses, but a securities brokerage deriving large offshore principal dealing gains must prove that losses were not manipulated through related party pricing. Losses from foreign permanent establishments may only offset foreign-source income categories.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 17 / Box 17 - Tax Payable before Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income multiplied by the applicable 25% rate, before deductions and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a preferential rate or a unilateral tax credit is claimed, file the corresponding schedule and preserve the approval or qualification certificate. The JV must not use a non-resident investor's tax rate to compute the Chinese entity's tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 18 / Box 18 - Foreign Tax Credit and Prior Payments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable foreign income tax paid, plus quarterly provisional CIT paid during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are limited by the Chinese tax payable on the foreign-source portion. To claim a credit, obtain foreign tax payment vouchers and certified translations. Any withholding tax paid in a foreign jurisdiction on brokerage earnings must be accompanied by proof of actual payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 19 / Box 19 - Final Tax Payable or Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed as tax payable after credits less cumulative quarterly payments; this is the residual amount to be paid or refunded with the annual return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any distribution or deemed distribution of profits to a non-resident parent must be addressed in the dividend withholding tax return, not in this line. If a refund of overwithheld non-resident tax is claimed, the JV and the foreign recipient must jointly apply to the competent tax authority with supporting treaty documentation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a statutory fine under Article 62 of the Law on Tax Collection and Administration from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000, increased to RMB 20,000 in serious cases, plus daily late payment interest of 0.05% on unpaid tax under Article 32. Failure to pay tax by intentional concealment or false declaration constitutes tax evasion under Article 63, carrying a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax and criminal referral when the amount exceeds RMB 50,000 and is over 10% of the tax payable. Withholding agents that fail to withhold the 10% outbound withholding tax may be penalized under Articles 68 and 69, and the responsible directors may be added to the tax-related credit blacklist, triggering travel bans and asset enforcement.
